key_insight: CoRPS-Dial separates patient personas from clinical workflows to generate realistic, controllable pre-consultation medical dialogues.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support training medical dialogue systems when access to real patient conversations is constrained by privacy and ethical concerns.
method: Pair a persona-driven patient agent with a process-guided doctor agent.
Guide conversations with guideline-aligned clinical workflow rules.
Apply post-hoc checks for role consistency, workflow completeness, and textual consistency.
evidence_signal: In coronary heart disease experiments, the authors report improved alignment with real dialogues in information coverage, clinical compliance, and naturalness, plus benefits for downstream fine-tuning; the abstract provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: Generalizability beyond coronary heart disease and safety in real clinical use remain unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: Decoupling Patient Personas and Clinical Workflows: A Dual-Agent Approach to Realistic Medical Dialogue Generation
